title: Integration governance
explain: API sprawl and shadow integrations are enterprise risk. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Integration governance" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Integration governance, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Integration governance without a failure story
howToApply: Use Integration governance explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Integration governance” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Integration → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Integration governance” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Integration governance” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Integration governance”.

designTradeoffs.optionB: Dual-write both systems in one UI tx
